title: State & Change
reward: Learn that change needs a reference state.
knowledge: Distinguish first-seen, changed, disappeared and returned behavior.
Absence is not disproof; presence is not persistence.
Compare scoped baselines before calling deviation meaningful.
Configuration and deployment changes can move legitimate baselines.
Track supporting and conflicting evidence across days.
challenge: Explain a change against a prior state.
Name evidence that would falsify the preferred hypothesis.
next_requires: Use history rather than novelty as a verdict.
